title: Neurobiological developmental trajectories in idiopathic autism: a calibrated pruning-splicing model and multicentre in-silico trial (code and derived data)
description: Code, derived data, posterior samples, simulation outputs, figures and tables reproducing the manuscript 'Neurobiological developmental trajectories in idiopathic autism: a calibrated pruning-splicing model and multicentre in-silico trial define the design for stratification and individual prediction'. The repository contains a minimal biophysical model of the pruning-splicing loop calibrated by approximate Bayesian computation, validation against the BrainSpan atlas and three independent GEO post-mortem autism cohorts, a SFARI genetic-loading analysis, and in-silico longitudinal and multicentre trials including a maximum-likelihood random-intercept cross-lagged panel model. A single script reproduces every number, table and figure from public raw data.
